pois.name: Grande Arche de la Défense
pois.description: Johan Otto von Spreckelsen's 1989 hollow cube (110m). Aligned on the Grand Axis from the Louvre through the Arc de Triomphe. Roof terrace open to visitors.

pois.name: Tour First
pois.description: France's tallest skyscraper at 231m (2011 renovation). Its tapering glass envelope houses BNP Paribas Real Estate and is the apex of La Défense's skyline.

pois.name: Esplanade de la Défense
pois.description: One of the world's largest outdoor sculpture parks, free to explore. 60+ contemporary works by Calder, Miró, César and Torricini among the towers.

pois.name: CNIT
pois.description: Nicolas Esquillan's 1958 reinforced concrete shell — still one of the largest in the world. A single triangular vault spans 218m with no interior columns.
